name: @crocodile/coordinator
description: Crocodile coordination server: accounts metadata, presence, signalling and host election. Never carries voice or text.

scripts.build: esbuild src/bin.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=esm --outfile=dist/bin.js --banner:js="import { createRequire as __cr } from 'node:module'; const require = __cr(import.meta.url);"
